title: BNPL Management Dashboard: Including or Excluding Closed BNPL Plans
summary: This document explains how to control BNPL Management Dashboard visibility of closed (fully repaid) BNPL plans using an inclusion setting: when the setting is true, closed plans appear in the list and visualizations; when false, only active plans are shown. It also lists reasons to include/exclude closed plans and guidance to toggle based on retrospective analysis vs day-to-day operations, with closed plans clearly labeled.
